scope: One bounded source-only pass through ordinary nativeFP32 RTConstant/RTPack/RTFinishAccumulation/RetainedSum32/RTExact and their current native route/mode contracts. No history catalogue, DAG study, numerical emulation, compiler, provider or new apparatus.

current_facts.fact: Native RTConstant still calls RTPack(x,+0,+0,+0). Only SIRIUS_RETAINED_PORTABLE already uses a bound check plus direct canonical five-field construction.

RTPack validates allthree limbs against magnitude bits0x7b800000, then RTFinishAccumulation validates nonnegative error and performs five ordered RetainedSum32 calls, assigns unchangederror andvalid1, and rechecks high bound.

Native RetainedSum32 magnitudeorders by rawabsbits then hi=a+b;lo=b-(hi-a), using three distinct NoContraction operations. RPBounded is absbits<=limit;0x7b800000 is inclusive2^120. Nonfinite and finitevalues beyond that bound must retain invalid behavior.
Ordinarynative RPScalar is float;RPBits/asuint exposes words,RPZero uses asfloat(0u),native RPScalarEqual uses float==. OrderedAdd/Sub are explicit SPIR-V NoContraction FAdd/FSub.
RTExact is a predicate,not a constructor. Numeric zero equality does not distinguish signedzero,whereas rawwords and RTNegate sign-bit XOR do.

Ordinarynative routing requires denormal preservation and nearest rounding. Its builder requires DenormPreserve32/RTE32/NoContraction and rejects relaxed arithmetic. SignedZeroInfNanPreserve32 request and corresponding host eligibility are added only for FMA,which ordinaryFP32 doesnot select.
